about_the_game:
* DEMO MAP AND MAIN GAME MAPS MAY BE SIMILAR *

  • Only the Neptune's Bath and Stylized Egypt maps will be available in the demo.

  • Once the full game is released, the number of maps will increase to 10 and will continue to expand regularly.

  • Players can use the purchase menu to buy items, collect trash scattered across the map, remove walls, change their colors, and sell specially assigned items.

  • The demo will support up to 2 players.

  • To join a lobby, right-click your friend from your Steam friends list and select “Join.”

  • This is also explained in the lobby menu under the “Info” icon at the top right corner.

  • Each session within the map is limited to 20 minutes of gameplay. Once this time runs out, players must escape using their spaceship.

  • There are two additional game modes that will be available in the full version but are not active in the demo.

name: Epoch Makers Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel i5 7400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon™ RX 570 / NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are subject to change as the game is still in development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel i5 9600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 5600 / NVIDIA GEFORCE RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are subject to change as the game is still in development.

short_description: Step into the past and rebuild history with Epoch Makers Demo, a cooperative renovation and restoration simulation designed for your buddies. Work together to repair, clean, and reconstruct some of the world’s most iconic historical landmarks.
